claim_title: Scale-Dependent Emergence — personal vs attributed belief across Pythia sizes

figures.caption: Personal-belief and attributed-belief accuracy across Pythia scales (third-person 454-item subset). Attributed-belief shows a sharp step-function emergence at 1B (0.460 -> 0.859 -> 0.905); personal-belief is non-monotonic with a dip at 1B (0.855 -> 0.782 -> 0.993). White asterisk marks above-chance (p < 0.05, one-sided binomial). pythia-410m attributed-belief sits at chance (acc = 0.460, p = 0.96).
